verification.word_id_source: November 2025 official HSK 3.0 syllabus; entries 301–500, preserving source serial ID and order. Transcribed from the referenced 2025 syllabus table.
verification.sentence_policy: Two examples per headword. Sentence 1 (style=conversational) models natural interactive or everyday spoken usage, including neutral spoken statements. Sentence 2 (style=written; register=plain_written) models clear beginner-level descriptive, narrative, explanatory, instructional, or quoted written text. Neither style is exclusive to its medium; written does not mean formal/literary, and natural speech/writing overlap. Prefer HSK 3.0 Levels 1–2 vocabulary and grammar; do not force advanced vocabulary to create artificial register differences.
verification.translation_policy: Chinese sentences, pinyin, English meanings, and translations are newly prepared editorial material. They are not individually corpus-attested or independently native-speaker certified.
verification.pinyin_policy: Tone-marked official syllable pinyin for headwords; sentence pinyin is editorial, assembled from 2025 Levels 1–2 lexicon and Unicode Han-Latin transliteration for out-of-list characters, with curated neutral-tone/tone-sandhi handling. Manual proofreading recommended.
verification.taxonomy_policy: Use the 22 shared top-level topics and 25 subtopics from taxonomy v2.0.0.
verification.vocabulary_boundary_policy: Hard ceiling: November 2025 HSK 3.0 Level 2 cumulative vocabulary (IDs 1–500). Level 1 examples may use Level 2 items; Level 3+ standalone vocabulary is not intentionally introduced. Normal grammar particles and contracted negative 没 (short form of 没有) are allowed; orthographic parts inside a listed word are not treated as separate unlisted vocabulary. Original lexical lists do not encode every compositional collocation. Independent linguistic/native-speaker verification has not been performed.
verification.vocabulary_boundary_audit: Prior releases underwent heuristic vocabulary segmentation and character coverage screening. In v1.1.1, revised examples were editorially reviewed for beginner vocabulary. No independent full word-level audit was performed for this release.
verification.sentence_revision: v1.1.1: Revised selected conversational and plain-written examples and standardized selected plural-suffix spacing in pinyin. Prior vocabulary screening was heuristic. Strict cumulative HSK 1–2 compliance has not been independently verified at the word level for this release.

changelog.changes: Applied a strict cumulative HSK 3.0 Levels 1–2 vocabulary ceiling for examples. Revised 6 example sentences in Level 2; removed words above Level 2, unlisted classifiers and proper names from those examples. Official headwords, IDs, other examples, classifications, and topic taxonomy unchanged. Kept the HSK 1 negative adverb 没 as a normal short form of 没有 where relevant.

Clarified that conversational/written are pedagogical use contexts, not mutually exclusive formal registers; upgraded 15 written examples with fuller HSK 1–2-level descriptive or narrative contexts at IDs 303, 307, 314, 334, 335, 355, 370, 375, 383, 396, 400, 417, 419, 429, 487. Preserved official IDs, headwords, meanings, topics, POS, all 200 conversational examples and the other 185 written examples.

Reviewed external feedback: revised examples for IDs 316, 360, 405, and both examples at 431; updated the meaning and usage note for 时 (431); corrected tone sandhi in both examples at 449 (一万 → yí wàn). Retained the existing natural example for 445 and 名 classifier at 449 (official Level 2 ID 404). No change to headwords, HSK IDs, POS, topics, or other sentences.
Initial HSK 3.0 Level 2 vocabulary entries 301–500 with two Mandarin examples per entry, pinyin, English, POS classifications, and shared topic taxonomy.

Taxonomy-only release: migrated from 20 to 22 top-level semantic topics (taxonomy v2.0.0), added 25 hierarchical subtopics and per-entry primary_subtopic_id/subtopic_ids. Reassigned selected primary/secondary topics; preserved all official IDs, headwords, pinyin, meanings, POS, and both example objects byte-for-byte at JSON value level. Source release 1.0.3.

Revised Chinese examples at IDs 342, 352, 386, 416, 435, 439, 454, 464, 477, and 498. Corrected sentence pinyin at IDs 320, 388, and 484, and standardized pinyin spacing for selected plural nouns. Synchronized taxonomy metadata with v2.0.0 and clarified the scope of vocabulary verification.

taxonomy.topic_policy: primary_topic_id is one active top-level parent; topic_ids begins with primary and permits meaningful secondary parents. primary_subtopic_id and subtopic_ids are optional for categories without subdivisions. All subtopic IDs must belong to parent topic_ids. Not official HSK categories.
taxonomy.pos_policy: primary_pos_id selects the most useful beginner lexical function, not an exclusive analysis; pos_ids includes independently documented secondary roles. Words like 几 (interrogative quantity) are not classifiers merely because they take classifiers after them. Secondary adverbial uses may be beyond beginner level; see pos_note.
